name: Create Discussion v2
purpose: API operation that creates a Discussion on an entity (Party, Activity, Sales Transaction or Opportunity) inside a DBTransactions transaction. It validates EntityId and EntityTypeId, derives the discussion title from the entity (party name; activity subject; "#docNumber - customer name"; opportunity's party name), sets the Discussion date/time/title and the discussion indicator on the activity, optionally creates a first comment (Create ActivityComment), builds the activity-party list (creator role 50, subscribers role 64) and creates the Activity (type 10) through _Create Activity. Returns Id, EntityId, EntityTypeId, ActivityCommentId and Title.
